Continue Pete Large's already-authorized MH370 estimator implementation in this same owner thread. This direct queued continuation follows actual scientific work and the checked report at 18:00 UTC on 18 September; it is not a new goal. Read the newest plan.md/progress.md in branching-filter-analysis and inspect processes. No subagents or new threads. Preserve canonical code, physical priors/likelihoods, no truth tuning and no unchanged failed repeats or arbitrary old limits.

New results: exact innovation-space particle Gibbs with full ancestor sampling, absent from the archived failed replay methods, passes exact finite reference tests and independent flight/suffix checks. Unlike ordinary particle Gibbs, it revises initial physical histories. Two 64-particle/512-sweep continuations made 79/229 initial changes but retain 58.37-point coordinate CDF disagreement. The subsequent fixed likelihood-only replica exchange pair (five powers, 128 sweeps, 291 seconds) passed all probability checks but retains 81.54-point disagreement. That exchange extension was archived and removed from active temporary source; do not rerun it or enlarge it unchanged. No sampler remains active. Existing impact/drift/search PDFs are scientifically unchanged. Current checked 19-page report: terminal-refined-mixture/mixed/model-mixture/report/; 17 embedded graphics, 50 checked links, 456-word explanation.

Next concrete task: diagnose full-suffix predecessor concentration. Approximately 26 effective incoming prefixes contract to about one compatible predecessor at block two. Read cruise-ancestor-sampling/suffix-diagnosis-plan.json and predecessor-concentration.json. Two saved references were prepared without truth: seed 37118201, original iteration 270; seed 37118202, original iteration 7. Instrument one deterministic conditional update for each, preserving original RNG iteration, to save incoming weights, each suffix observation log likelihood and each prior/proposal correction separately. Include shared BFO-bias and applicable fuel state; keep the complete observation configuration so fuel remains at 00:11, not at the 19:41 diagnostic endpoint. Verify selected innovations, physical state, ancestor choices and full target factors exactly reproduce their recorded updates. This is new instrumentation of saved controls, not another unchanged inference ensemble. Use the decomposition to identify a concrete correction before any new sampling; independently validate its mathematics first. Do not infer that likelihood tempering solves a concentration caused by proposal corrections or by how retained simulator innovations couple histories.

Active isolated source /tmp/mh370-cruise-ancestor-sampling was restored to cruise-ancestor-sampling/suffix-checked-source.tar.gz after removal of the exchange extension. Its target executable is stale; rebuild after instrumentation or use a specifically frozen executable. Frozen exchange source and executable remain only as reproducibility artifacts. No core prototype is integrated into the product. Main code changes are report generation plus independent .sources reference work. Other project work may modify canonical files; do not overwrite it. Continue useful implementation/diagnosis, current process reporting and browser updates. Stable cruise recovery and fine search rankings are not achieved. A queued message is not evidence of unattended execution.

Current proposal-only gap experiments leave ancestry collapse; saved all-candidate averaging showed the random candidate selection was not the primary cause. Distinguish a new correction from those rejected approaches. Validate any proposed transition or importance correction with independent reference calculations before a small matched synthetic control; preserve physical priors and likelihoods and never tune proposals to generating truth. Do useful implementation or diagnosis rather than only acknowledge this prompt. Maintain concise updates, current process status, reproducible provenance and results/limitations. The latest status audit is owner-status-audit.json. Do not claim unattended progress merely because a message is queued or scheduled.
